mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls above 0.3% per month signals stronger employment growth, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of above-threshold payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in the Housing Starts Index exceeding 10% signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of above-threshold housing starts declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the Industrial Production Index above 0.5% signals stronger manufacturing activity, which increases corporate earnings and supports higher equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of above-threshold industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in CPI above 0.5% signals easing inflationary pressure, which reduces the probability of aggressive Fed tightening and supports higher equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of above-threshold CPI declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate above 0.3% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of above-threshold unemployment increases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Income above 0.5% signals reduced household purchasing power, which lowers consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of above-threshold real income declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate above 0.25% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of above-threshold federal funds rate increases (t-test p > 0.05).
